en: Black‑and‑white view of a large, ornate country hotel or inn beside a wide dirt road, with low hills and woods in the background. The multi‑storey building has steep gabled roofs, balconies with wooden railings, and decorative trim typical of Central European architecture. Small blossoming trees line the front. On the road in the foreground a woman pushes a pram and another woman stands nearby in long early‑20th‑century dress. Faint signage is visible on the façade of the building.
